name: agent-autopilot
description: Answers AskUserQuestion polls for you only when the assistant marked one option (Recommended) and nothing looks irreversible; default is a hint.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off: do nothing; hint: show a star under the recommended option, you still answer; auto: answer for you; shadow: show nothing, only record the recommendation and your pick; /autopilot auto switches it on for one session only

limit.title: Answers per session
limit.description: Most polls answered for you in one session; the next ones go to you

extraDeny.title: Extra irreversible words
extraDeny.description: Comma-separated words that send a poll to you, added to the built-in list; matched as whole words (Cyrillic ones by their start)

guess.title: Model guess in shadow
guess.description: In shadow mode, haiku (your Claude Code subscription) guesses which option you would pick for a poll with no single recommended option, and the guess is only written to the journal, kept apart from the rule's measure; never shown, never acted on

logSize.title: Journal size
logSize.description: Entries of the answer journal kept per session
